label: R2010
comment: The 2010 crack: the original Melbourne House files (M.PROG, M.SHAPES, M.CHSET, M.XSPRITES and the loading files) with a KERNAL loader of the crackers. Captured at the game entry $1158.

label: SHADOW
comment: The Shadow crack (Copenhagen Crackers intro): version I packed into the file EXPLODING FIST2, started by the intro file EXPLODING FIST. A memory dump of a game that ran: self-modified operands, the music workspace and the sprite buffers hold run-time values. Captured at the game entry $1158.
